integrity.claim_domain: Fifteen unordered two-subsets of a six-point set, adjacency iff disjoint, ordinary disconnected-triple cut complex.
integrity.method: Alexander-dual face classification, ten disjoint-support join-sphere boundary blocks, integral primitivity, duality, Hurewicz and Whitehead.
integrity.reproducibility: verify.py and verify_output.txt are included as standalone exact finite checks; the human-readable proof supplies the noncomputational steps.

scientific_limitations: Exact result for the ordinary three-cut complex of the single 15-vertex Kneser graph, not a uniform family result.
No classification of homology automorphism modules, total-cut complexes, or higher cut parameters.
The separate modular boundary computations corroborate the integral structural proof but cannot alone establish torsion-freeness.
Unindexed or inaccessible equivalent research remains a literature-completeness risk; no external independent audit was performed.
title: Mixed-dimensional homotopy of the ordinary three-cut complex of \(KG(6,2)\)
